Solution: We know $4 \times 9 = 36$. We want $36 \equiv 3 \pmod n$, which means $n$ divides $36 - 3 = 33$. The positive divisors of 33 are 1, 3, 11, and 33. Since $1 \in \{0,...,n-1\}$, we must have $n > 1$. The smallest positive such $n$ is 3.
